def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(a and b for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)):
        return left
    return [[a if a else b for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(left, right)]
